visualAssessment.identity: The rendered portal mark, cameo silhouettes, invitation ticket, arched playbill and lavender daylight counterpart remain theatre-specific; no sibling paper/jelly branding was found.
visualAssessment.hierarchy: Quiet textarea and complete verse remain the content focus. Different entry, roster, ticket, reading, recovery, native-control and export compositions replace a catch-all specimen card.
visualAssessment.wholePoem: All nine lines are mounted together and never advanced line by line. Normal shared-screen sample fits in one 1440×900 viewport; long words and 200% text scroll naturally rather than being clipped or shrunk.
reviewAdjudications: Unexpected-room-state is intentionally a disconnected generic error boundary with Try again/Home recovery; inventing a specific live backend cause would be misleading.

Release fixtures remain clearly illustrative rather than inventing real release history. Primitive button specimens intentionally label button roles. Neither is a catch-all renderer used for unrelated inventory IDs.

The long-name input uses native horizontal caret scrolling, not ellipsis or a clipped static label: all 38 characters remained in value, End reached position 38 and scrolled the field 37px; document width remained contained.
Private keep and a separate public-link-options action are not contradictory. Ten blocked public fixtures and both cancellation/revocation paths were exercised without exposed private content.

toolingNotes: Shared-browser background throttling caused helper click waits and a shared VM loss. No reset was requested. Native Puppeteer controls completed the flow, and final captures used the dedicated CDP browser.

Dedicated CDP fullPage:true cropped the rightmost scrollbar-width pixels. Final default/core/sensory captures use an explicit innerWidth clip with captureBeyondViewport; complete screenshots, not cropped tool output, informed final judgments.
Temporary contact-sheet crop errors were corrected before final review.
unexercisedLimits: No real multiplayer room, authentication, persistence, provider account, public publication or network recovery was exercised. These are explicitly offline local state fixtures.
Headless audio was not actually audible to the verifier. Browser Web Audio context/node events and cue acknowledgement were observed; sound quality or loudness is not claimed.
Text was enlarged to 200% with a 32px root font. Physical mobile software keyboards, assistive-technology speech output and operating-system display zoom were not tested.
Native print/share dialogs, PNG/RSS download contents, clipboard permissions, installation behavior and QR decoding were not exercised; their assigned rendered specimens were inspected.
Every ID was inspected in its default state; this is not a claim that every possible state in every inventory entry was exercised. The additional states and controls are enumerated above.
